basic_info.description: Welcome to 401 Huron Avenue, a stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom Marina-style home with a versatile bonus room, nestled on a fantastic, sunny corner lot. This charming residence is filled with lovely period details and an abundance of natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The spacious living room and formal dining room, both brimming with character, offer the ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining. The living room features a fabulous mantle, a cozy fireplace, and expansive windows that flood the space with sunlight. The large kitchen includes a delightful breakfast nookperfect for enjoying your morning coffee or transforming into a convenient home office. The bright, cheerful bedrooms are bathed in an incredible afternoon glow, adding to the home's inviting charm. On the lower level, you'll find a spacious family room/bonus room and an additional bathroom, perfect for entertaining or hosting guests during the holidays. Outdoor living is a breeze with the expansive patio and beautifully manicured backyard, offering the ideal setting for indoor-outdoor entertaining. This home truly embodies comfort, charm, and timeless elegance.
